context: Two teens debrief a stressful school day on the way home
purpose: Teach: 瞳/斜め/今頃/抱く/癒さ/つくづく/到底/ツボ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日のテスト、つくづく嫌になったわ。もう到底無理だって途中で気づいた。
lines.en: Today's test really wore me down. Halfway through I realized it was totally impossible.
lines.style: Exhausted teen venting frustration to a close friend after school.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。先生が問題配った瞬間、俺の瞳が死んだもん。
lines.en: I get it. The moment the teacher handed out the questions, my eyes went dead.
lines.style: Dry humor delivered with slumped shoulders and a tired half-smile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 斜め前の田中くん、ずっと頭抱えてたよね。今頃職員室で説教されてるかも。
lines.en: Tanaka, who sat diagonally in front, kept holding his head. He's probably getting lectured in the staff room right now.
lines.style: Gossipy and slightly sympathetic, glancing back as they walk together.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、それ俺の笑いのツボなんだけど。あいつ大げさに頭抱くから余計面白い。
lines.en: Ugh, that hits my funny bone perfectly. He clutches his head so dramatically, it just makes it funnier.
lines.style: Laughing properly for the first time, voice lifting with genuine amusement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、笑わせないでよ。お腹痛い。コンビニ寄って甘いもの買お、心が癒されたい。
lines.en: Hey, stop making me laugh, my stomach hurts. Let's stop at the convenience store for something sweet, I need to be healed.
lines.style: Playful protest mixed with a real plea for comfort food.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 賛成。アイス食って全部忘れよう。
lines.en: Agreed. Let's eat ice cream and forget all of it.
lines.style: Quick, decisive agreement with a small relieved smile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんと、リクといると楽になる。一人だったらつくづく落ち込んでたと思う。
lines.en: Honestly, hanging out with you makes things easier. If I'd been alone, I really would have been down in the dumps.
lines.style: Softer, sincere tone — a quiet thank-you between close friends.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おう、明日もどうせ補習だしな。お互いさまだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, well, we've got make-up classes tomorrow anyway. We're in the same boat.
lines.style: Casual brush-off hiding genuine warmth, hands in pockets.
